    pid_c = tl.program_id(1)

    acc = 0.0

        acc += tl.sum(prod, axis=0)

    # Add bias

    acc = acc + b_val

    # Store y[n, c, h, w]

    y_sC = y_ptr.stride(1)
    y_sH = y_ptr.stride(2)
    y_sW = y_ptr.stride(3)
